appearance_facts.fact: Chart title is 'Incidence of Condition A in US States'.
Legend is a vertical color bar labeled 'Low' at the bottom (value 0) and 'High' at the top (value 100).
State NH is colored light yellow, indicating a low incidence value.
State FL is colored dark red, indicating a high incidence value.
State DE is colored orange, indicating a medium incidence value.
The state NH is positioned in the northeastern corner of the map.
The state FL is positioned in the southeastern corner of the map.
The state DE is positioned in the mid-Atlantic region, to the east of PA and north of MD.

printed_facts.fact: State FL is shaded dark red, corresponding to the highest end of the scale.
State NH is shaded light yellow, corresponding to the lowest end of the scale.
State DE is shaded orange, corresponding to a mid-range value on the scale.

public_definitions: Review the state prevalence dashboard, then open the state statistics view that should be routed into the highest-prevalence priority follow-up workflow.
Use the state prevalence dashboard as the evidence source for the state priority view routing decision.
Highest-prevalence state statistics route: Select the option corresponding to the state with the highest incidence value on the dashboard.
